_comment: Registration for The Spine. Field names/shape are this project's own convention - no external Spine schema was available to verify against. Every *_ref points at real code in this repo.

agent.name: cv-screener
agent.description: Screens a candidate CV for fitness as a BGO call center agent and produces a hiring recommendation scorecard.

skills.name: check_qualifications
skills.description: Runs deterministic checks (experience, skills, red flags) against CV text and returns structured findings.
